answer: One strong defense is a work-backed identity bond: before an agent can earn, it must lock a stake and complete verifiable, costly work — like a river carving basalt, slow and undeniable. Cheap copies cannot fake that cost at scale. A reputation bridge then links each identity to its proven history, so a fresh fake starts with zero trust and must pay the same price again, making a thousand Sybils a thousand times more expensive than one honest agent.
